'''Briain''' was a ''[[Far Dareis Mai]]'' of an unknown clan. 

== Appearance ==
She had a round face.

== Activities ==
She was part of [[Perrin Aybara]]'s army that goes into [[Ghealdan]]. She searched for traces of [[Faile Bashere]] when Faile was captured by the [[Shaido]].

She was killed while taking out the Shaido sentries around [[Malden]].
